limitations: No original JVM, GUI, GL initialization, framebuffer or random stream executed. Assumes original Mobject GL initialization succeeds.
Fixed render-mode dt is explicit; native interactive millis first-dt0 behavior is not modeled.
Python and JS host double transcendental low bits may differ; compare finite doubles at declared tolerance, Float32 camera bits exactly.
Parameter getter cases here use numeric values/defaults only; malformed scalar/schema/whole-source import coverage belongs to separate boundary tests.
Independent parameter names have order-independent final writes. Per-frame key write list is diagnostic; native JSONObject HashMap traversal order is not asserted.
Write dirty means a call to updateParameter, not a claim of rendered clearing/6x compensation coverage.
